description: NI 168 - Proportion of principal roads where maintenance should be considered is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Transport. The indicator measures the percentage of the local authority's A-road and M-road network where maintenance should be considered. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2014-02-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
